## 01_airbnb_prepare.R

### Changes Made

```{r changes-airbnb-prepare, echo=FALSE}
changes_airbnb <- data.frame(
  `What was there before` = c(
    "Hard-coded input path",
    "Hard-coded output path",
    "No required-column check",
    "Christchurch filter only",
    "Snapshot metadata added manually",

    "Repeated license check",
    "Basic output-file check",
    "Output directory assumed to exist"
  ),

  `What we changed / added` = c(
    "Added input_file variable",
    "Added output_file variable",
    "Added required-column validation",
    "Added Christchurch filtering validation",
    "Added June 2026 validation",
    "Show only columns with missing values",
    "Added zero-review vs reviewed summary",

    "Renamed high_price_listings to top_price_listings",
    "Added zero/negative minimum_nights validation",

    "Reduce unnecessary console output.",
    "Support the decision to retain missing review fields.",
    "Prevent invalid prices entering the pipeline.",
    "Describe inspection without implying automatic removal.",
    "Prevent invalid values entering the pipeline.",
    "Ensure one record per listing.",
    "Prevent important categorical fields being silently missing.",
    "Reduce console output while retaining investigation.",
    "Prevent invalid numerical values continuing downstream.",
    "Verify the cleaning decision occurred.",
    "Make final QA an actual pipeline gate.",
    "Avoid checking the same thing twice.",
    "Make output verification clearer.",
    "Prevent saving from failing if the directory is missing."

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE

knitr::kable(
  changes_airbnb,

## 02_airbnb_combine.R
### Changes Made

```{r changes-airbnb-combine, echo=FALSE}
changes_airbnb_combine <- data.frame(
  `What was there before` = c(
    "Monthly input files were listed directly in the script.",
    "There was no explicit check that the expected October 2025–June 2026 files were supplied.",
    "Monthly datasets were loaded without checking that their column structures matched.",
    "Christchurch filtering was performed, but the result was not automatically validated.",
    "The month_year metadata was created but not formally validated.",
    "Row-count checks relied mainly on printed output.",
    "Missing-value information was printed across all columns.",
    "Missing host_name values were inspected but not formally checked.",
    "Price missingness by month was inspected manually.",
    "Missing minimum_nights values were printed individually.",
    "Missing last_review values were inspected manually.",
    "Missing reviews_per_month values were inspected manually.",
    "The license column was identified as completely missing and removed.",
    "Columns selected for removal were not automatically checked after cleaning.",
    "The column-cleaning step did not explicitly verify that the row count was unchanged.",
    "Complete duplicate rows were inspected manually.",
    "Duplicate listing IDs within the same month were inspected manually.",
    "Repeated listing IDs across months were identified as expected.",
    "The final dataset was not explicitly checked for the expected monthly coverage.",
    "The output file was written without an explicit file-existence check."
  ),

  `What we changed / added` = c(
    "Created input_files and output_file variables so file paths are defined once and reused.",
    "Added validation for the expected nine monthly input files.",
    "Added a check that all monthly datasets have the same column structure.",
    "Added checks that each monthly dataset contains Christchurch records and no non-Christchurch records after filtering.",
    "Added validation that each dataset has the correct month_year value.",
    "Replaced redundant row-count printing with assertions comparing expected and actual row counts.",
    "Created a reusable missing_summary containing only columns with missing values.",
    "Created a reusable check for missing host_name values.",
    "Created price_by_month to summarise missing and non-missing prices and validate the expected fully missing months.",
    "Summarised missing minimum_nights values rather than printing every affected row.",
    "Created a reusable check to confirm that missing last_review values occur with zero reviews.",
    "Created a reusable check to confirm that missing reviews_per_month values occur with zero reviews.",
    "Added an assertion that license is completely missing before relying on its removal decision.",
    "Added a check confirming that all intended columns were removed.",
    "Added a check confirming that column cleaning did not change the number of rows.",
    "Converted the duplicate-row inspection into an assertion that stops if complete duplicates exist.",
    "Added an assertion that each listing ID occurs at most once within a month.",
    "Added a check confirming that listing IDs can legitimately repeat across different months.",
    "Added a final validation that all nine expected monthly snapshots remain in the cleaned dataset.",
    "Added an output-file existence check after writing the cleaned CSV."
  ),

  `Why` = c(
    "Avoids repeating file paths and makes the script easier to maintain.",
    "Prevents the analysis from silently using an incomplete or incorrect time period.",
    "Ensures that the monthly datasets can be safely combined.",
    "Ensures that the combined dataset contains only the intended Christchurch records.",
    "Prevents incorrect or inconsistent snapshot dates from entering the combined dataset.",
    "Turns an important structural assumption into an automatic validation.",
    "Makes missing-data inspection easier to interpret and reduces unnecessary output.",
    "Documents the observed missing host_name value while allowing unexpected changes to be detected.",
    "Makes the documented price-missingness pattern reproducible and testable.",
    "Provides a concise summary while retaining the decision not to impute missing values.",
    "Makes the documented relationship between missing dates and zero reviews testable.",
    "Makes the documented relationship between missing review rates and zero reviews testable.",
    "Prevents the script from removing license if the underlying missingness assumption changes.",
    "Ensures that the implemented cleaning matches the documented cleaning decisions.",
    "Column removal should not remove observations, so the row count should remain unchanged.",
    "Protects against accidental duplication of identical records.",
    "A listing may appear in multiple monthly snapshots, but should occur only once within each snapshot.",
    "Distinguishes legitimate longitudinal repetition from within-month duplication.",
    "Ensures that cleaning does not accidentally remove or alter the required study-period coverage.",
    "Confirms that the expected cleaned dataset was actually created."
  ),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  changes_airbnb_combine,
  caption = "Changes made to 02_airbnb_combine.R",
  align = c("l", "l", "l")
)





## 03_tenancy_prepare.R
### Changes Made

```{r changes-tenancy-prepare, echo=FALSE}

changes_tenancy <- data.frame(
  `What was there before` = c(
    "The raw Tenancy input path was defined directly in the script.",
    "The script loaded the raw file without checking that the file existed.",
    "The expected Tenancy columns were assumed to exist.",
    "TimeFrame was inspected through printed summaries only.",
    "Location Id structure was inspected but not automatically validated.",
    "Dwelling Type was inspected through printed counts and missing-value checks.",
    "Number Of Beds was inspected manually.",
    "Bond variables were inspected individually for missing and negative values.",
    "Rent variables were inspected for NULL values and unexpected text.",
    "The relationship between the four main rent measures was inspected manually.",
    "Log Std Dev Weekly Rent was inspected manually for NULL, zero and negative values.",
    "Reporting-unit uniqueness was checked through printed output.",
    "The rent-column list was defined again when the cleaning step was applied.",
    "The cleaned dataset dimensions were printed but not asserted.",
    "Rent columns were converted to numeric without a post-conversion type check.",
    "The reporting-unit key was checked again after cleaning using printed output.",
    "The project-period filter was applied without an explicit validation of the resulting periods.",
    "The output files were written without checking that they were successfully created.",
    "The processed output directory was assumed to already exist."
  ),

  `What we changed / added` = c(
    "Created reusable variables for the full and project-period output files.",
    "Added an explicit input-file existence check.",
    "Added validation that all required Tenancy variables are present.",
    "Added checks confirming TimeFrame is a Date, contains no missing values, and has multiple reporting periods.",
    "Added validation that numeric Location Id values contain six digits.",
    "Added validation for missing Dwelling Type values and the expected category structure.",
    "Added checks confirming Number Of Beds remains character and retains meaningful categories such as ALL and 5+.",
    "Added combined validation for missing and negative bond values.",
    "Added a check for unexpected non-numeric values before conversion.",
    "Added a reusable check for the NULL pattern across the four main rent measures.",
    "Added validation that Log Std Dev Weekly Rent contains no negative values while genuine zeros remain valid.",
    "Converted reporting-unit uniqueness into an explicit stop condition.",
    "Reused the existing rent_cols object instead of defining it twice.",
    "Added assertions that cleaning does not change the number of rows or columns.",
    "Added a post-cleaning check confirming all rent variables are numeric.",
    "Added a post-cleaning reporting-unit uniqueness check.",
    "Added validation that the project dataset contains the expected October 2025, January 2026 and April 2026 periods.",
    "Added checks confirming that both cleaned output files were created successfully.",
    "Added automatic creation of the processed-data directory when required."
  ),

  `Why` = c(
    "Keeps file paths defined once and makes the script easier to maintain.",
    "Provides a clear error before read_csv() fails because of a missing source file.",
    "Makes the structure required by the cleaning pipeline explicit.",
    "Protects the temporal structure required for quarterly analysis.",
    "Protects the documented six-digit structure without changing the special -99 and NULL source codes.",
    "Makes the documented Dwelling Type assumptions reproducible.",
    "Prevents inappropriate numeric conversion of values such as ALL and 5+.",
    "Makes the documented bond-quality assumptions automatically testable.",
    "Prevents unexpected text values from being silently converted to NA.",
    "Checks the documented finding that the four main rent measures are jointly unavailable on the same records.",
    "Protects the decision to retain genuine zero values while rejecting negative observations.",
    "Prevents duplicate reporting units from being silently carried into downstream analysis.",
    "Avoids repeated definitions and improves maintainability.",
    "Cleaning only converts values and types, so observations and variables should not be lost.",
    "Confirms that the intended numeric conversion actually occurred.",
    "Ensures that cleaning did not alter the reporting-unit structure.",
    "Makes the intended project-period restriction reproducible and testable.",
    "Confirms that the expected analysis files were actually produced.",
    "Prevents an avoidable failure when the output directory does not yet exist."
  ),

  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  changes_tenancy,
  caption = "Changes made to 03_tenancy_prepare.R",
  align = c("l", "l", "l")
)
